mainEntity.name: Copyfy or Shoplus: which one is the best?

acceptedAnswer.text: It all depends on your need. Copyfy is better for running an e-commerce business from A to Z: product research, store analysis, product pages and going live. Shoplus is better if you only want to dig through TikTok analytics. To launch and run a store, Copyfy wins; for pure TikTok analysis, Shoplus stays solid.

Neither: entry pricing is equivalent (49$/month against 49€/month). What differs is the scope — Shoplus handles TikTok analytics, Copyfy goes from product research to a live store. You can check it in a 5-day free trial, no credit card.

mainEntity.name: Which one has the best product research?

acceptedAnswer.text: Copyfy, no contest. Its AI targets winning products directly and analyzes competitor stores across several platforms, whereas Shoplus limits itself to viral products on TikTok. To move fast toward a product to launch, Copyfy's approach is more direct.

For most dropshippers, yes. Copyfy covers product research, competitor analysis, product pages and Shopify integration, and already includes part of the TikTok analysis. Shoplus keeps the edge on the depth of its TikTok analytics: if that network is your core business, it complements Copyfy well.

mainEntity.name: Can you test these tools for free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Copyfy offers a 5-day free trial, no credit card, plus a 5-day free trial. Shoplus offers a trial period. The simplest is to test Copyfy for free to see if the suite covers your need.
